      How it will work

      Four phases, same rules for everyone.

      Planned order. The exact times are announced here before launch.

      1. 1

        Snapshot

        Founding Supporters are counted at a cutoff announced in advance (the rules are below).

      2. 2

        Founders launch

        Each City Founder gets first right to launch their city's one official coin, with the ticker reserved for that city.

      3. 3

        Supporters first

        Founding Supporters buy before the public.

      4. 4

        Everyone

        The public joins. Every city coin keeps its real boundary, verified locals and moderators.

      Who gets in first

      Get your place before it opens.

      🏅

      Founding Supporters

      Hold $VICINITY through the 14 days before the snapshot. No sign-up needed: it's read from the blockchain.

      How it's counted →
      👑

      City Founders

      Backed by your city after holding its founder amount (100,000 to 1,000,000 $VICINITY, by city size) for 7 days. First right to launch its coin.

      Find your city →
      🛡️

      Country Managers

      Elected by each country's locals for 90 days. Advise on new towns and keep the country's coins clean.

      Roles →

      Founding Supporter snapshot

      Counted fairly. Checked by anyone.

      Every wallet counts as the lower of its balance at the cutoff and its average over the 14 days before, so renting tokens for a day doesn't help. Pools and team wallets are excluded. The result is published with a Merkle root and 48 hours to challenge it. The rules.

      Checking…

      Once the snapshot is published, paste any wallet to see its amount and Merkle proof.

      Why a city launchpad

      A coin with a place, people and rules.

      • No copycats. Each community gets exactly one official coin, and its ticker is reserved (London, UK is $LONDON; London, Canada is $LONDONCA).
      • Real holders. Locals are verified by wallet, location and one login per person.
      • Accountable leaders. Founders are chosen by locals and managers are elected; both keep their roles only while they hold, and nobody moderates alone.
      • Built for the long run. Every coin comes with its community's feed, check-ins and weekly votes.
